top_signals.title: Nasdaq 100 Sinks 10% From Peak, Set for Correction: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street got a reality check as a bruising selloff in technology shares fueled concern the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has powered the equity bull market might be overblown.

top_signals.title: Pentagon tells Europeans to cool their rhetoric on Russia, sources say
top_signals.summary: The officials argued that some statements by European leaders and officials have undermined continental security.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
